overview.description: The Fidelity MSCI North American Subset Index ETF (FINA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of large- and mid-cap companies from North America. The fund employs an optimizer to minimize its climate change impact while also screening against controversial business involvement. FINA was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by Fidelity.
infoTable: MSCI Global Climate 500 North America Selection Index

holdings.infoBox: FINA is an equity ETF with a total of 279 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.49%, Apple at 7.00%, Microsoft at 5.37%, Alphabet at 5.17%, and Amazon.com at 3.59%.
